  SELECT p.category, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT st.category, st.stock_units, sa.gross_units, sa.gross_excl_staff, coalesce(r.ret_units,0) ret_units,
  round(st.stock_units / (sa.gross_units/4.0),2) cover_gross,
  round(st.stock_units / ((sa.gross_units-coalesce(r.ret_units,0))/4.0),2) cover_net,
  round(st.stock_units / (sa.gross_excl_staff/4.0),2) cover_excl_staff
FROM stock st LEFT JOIN sales sa USING(category) LEFT JOIN rets r USING(category) ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(f.closing_units) AS stock_units
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
sold AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1),
returned AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT st.category,
  round(st.stock_units / ((sd.units_sold - coalesce(rt.units_returned, 0)) / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st JOIN sold sd USING (category) LEFT JOIN returned rt USING (category)
ORDER BY st.category
